stemMd: Which map feature would best satisfy the author's recommendation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A legend explaining classification rules and marking villages with mixed usage

options.label: B
options.textMd: A claim that every resident uses the majority form

options.label: C
options.textMd: Classification based only on village names

options.label: E
options.textMd: A thicker boundary line with no explanation

explanationMd: The recommendation is explicit: reveal the rule and show mixed usage where possible. A clear legend and mixed-use markers implement both parts.

distractorRationale.e: This strengthens the misleading appearance of sharpness.
